title: By the best cell counts, a typical man is about half human
caption: A typical 70 kg man has about 30 trillion human cells and about 38 trillion bacteria.
description: For a 70 kg reference man, Sender, Fuchs & Milo (2016) count about 30 trillion human cells and 38 trillion bacteria, about 1 to 1 and not the 10 to 1 once quoted; a 2023 census (Hatton et al.) puts the human cells nearer 36 trillion. Either way it is about half and half. By count most human cells are red blood cells; by mass, muscle and fat dominate.
sources: Sender, Fuchs & Milo, PLoS Biology 14(8): e1002533 (2016), doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.1002533
